newsitem.title: USA: Hormel cuts output at three pork plants.
newsitem.headline: Hormel cuts output at three pork plants.

text.p: Hormel Foods Corp said Wednesday it scaled back operations at three pork slaughtering plants due to poor market conditions that have affected pork processors industrywide.
Hormel's Fremont, Neb., and Rochelle, Ill., plants and its leased facility, Quality Pork Processors in Austin, are affected.

"We have slowed down chain speeds at all three of our pork slaughtering plants in response to the significant decline in hog numbers," V. Allan Krejci, director of public relations, said in a statement.
